window-1.title: Silk — Interactive Generative Art
window-1.blurb: Drag your cursor across the black and it blooms into mirrored threads of light — the rare web toy that feels hand-made and meditative rather than clever, and I think you'll lose a happy twenty minutes to it before screenshotting half of them as pattern refs.

window-2.title: Moats That Matter, Cross-Species Communication, & Taking Back Our Attention
window-2.blurb: Belsky reads the near-future like a designer rather than a tech bro, and this one detours from what makes an idea truly yours into AI-decoded animal language and clawing your attention back — basically three side quests in one newsletter.

window-3.title: Sparkling Hibiscus Sangria Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It's a whole magenta pitcher of hibiscus and floating fruit — basically built to be batched for your people, photographed on 35mm, and refilled twice before anyone notices there's no booze in it.

window-4.title: This Eclectic, Treasure-Filled Apartment Is Maximalism Done Right
window-4.blurb: A recovering minimalist turned full trinket-maximalist who furnished her whole character-filled apartment through Craigslist finds and sheer love of stuff — basically your interiors side quest, already in progress.

window-5.title: Elijah Pies Joo Chiat (new flagship)
window-5.blurb: A snow crab laksa pie is exactly the kind of heritage-meets-nonsense mashup you'd invent yourself, so go eat one in Joo Chiat before someone else claims the idea.
